# A fallback that another person can change

A procedure that only I may edit still depends on me. Put revision authority beside the owner field. [[Maintenance]] is moving from preserving objects to preserving the ability of a group to continue without a particular person. Keep the older notes because they show where the idea came from, not because every example needs to say the same thing.
